title: RAW UNREVIEWED: choose one treatment course once, versus choose a fresh alternative at each stage
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. A medical compiler can offer complete alternative treatment courses whose later references preserve the selected course. Compare one global alternative, fresh local alternatives at every step, and simultaneous performance of both. The distinguishable consequence is whether a written continuation may combine the first stage of one course with the second stage of the other; no Voynich word is assigned.

design.production: A compiler abbreviates repeated treatment stages but retains the scope of an initial choice. This is not a claim that physical manuscript lines delimit courses.
design.finite_content: Introduce courses A=(prepare material M, apply resulting M) and B=(prepare material N, apply resulting N). Global choice permits AA or BB histories. Stagewise choice also permits AB and BA. A combined-course reading performs both courses and needs two preparation results. The existence of an allowed mixed history therefore differentiates models beyond simply calling a connector AND or OR.
design.historical_motivation: research_registry/work_batches/ten_hours_20260915/TROTULA_IV15_V19_SOURCE_PACKET_20260920.md owns1544 print IV15: initial Vel scopes a recipe with ingredients, processing and administration; a second vel selects its wine medium. The source does not itself attest arbitrary multistage alternation or a mixed-history prohibition. The proposed scope-persistence law is an explicit authoring hypothesis, not a quotation or proven medieval universal.
design.existing_packet_to_author: GDT790's complete saved f82r P1 and P2 records, including the upper record already nominated by IDEA732. They are two actual text records, not independently identified treatment courses or a confirmed preparation/application pair. Use saved full units only. Do not treat two daiin fields or the drawing as two already identified ingredients. If the full records do not contain repeated written continuations, do not substitute a favorable line.
design.positive_structure: Reusable directed composition and whole-word residuals constrain whether a course identity is stable through varying constructions; the pX/yX paragraph contrast can constrain entry versus continuation positions only, never provide the semantic scope by itself.
design.frequency_rule: All prospective connector, material and reference forms require their full cached profiles and prior counterexamples. Common forms may be broad domain or function terms; none is presumed AND/OR. Readers stay separate and no substring equality establishes batch identity.
design.nearest_predecessors: IDEA732 already owns simultaneous ingredients versus alternative carriers, IDEA707 owns optional substitution, GDT1018 universal continuation choices, and1153 failed fixed prior-competitor prediction. Novel obligation is a single written choice whose scope extends across multiple stages. If the authored account reduces to one local ingredient alternative, this proposal is a duplicate and must not become a test. No1153 context rule is repaired.
design.likely_failure: An initial course label and all later references may be paid entirely by arbitrary assignments; then no real preference follows. The source example only motivates nested choice, not the specific native lifetime rule. A fresh batch can make mixed histories legitimate; its introduction must be explicit and costed rather than forbidden for convenience.
design.next_step: Draft complete A/B/C course accounts over the saved upper and companion records with one shared lexicon and expose every mixed-history obligation. Unknown preparation/material names may remain variables. Require an actual written dependency distinguishing histories before selecting any test.
